name: Optical Thickness Reduction via Similarity Relations
definition: A method to speed up Monte Carlo rendering of optically dense and forward-scattering materials by replacing original scattering parameters with altered parameters that result in fewer scattering events, without modifying the core rendering algorithm.
summary: Optical Thickness Reduction via Similarity Relations accelerates Monte Carlo rendering by replacing scattering parameters with altered ones that yield fewer events, using higher-order relations to capture complex phase functions without modifying the renderer.
